One‑line takeaway
Nvidia’s CEO return sparks a tech‑sector rally, while Tata’s review of Air India and the surge in EV sales amid price hikes and regulatory tightening signal a mixed outlook for India’s services and industrial‑support sectors.

What’s happening

  • Nvidia’s CEO comeback – Jensen Huang’s reinstatement after a brief exit has lifted Nvidia shares by ~35 % and lifted sentiment across tech stocks, including a 7 % rally in Nikkei and Kospi.
    43966410714401744074

  • Tata Sons review of Air India – Chairman N. Chandrasekaran has begun a review of Air India, Tata Digital and Tata Electronics after Noel Tata flagged losses of ₹29,000 cr, signalling potential restructuring or divestment.
    4377237491

  • EV sales surge vs. price hikes – India’s festive vehicle retail hit a record 55.25 lakh units, with EV sales up 52 % despite a 7 % dip in passenger vehicle sales; Hyundai announced a price hike of up to ₹8,000 on select models.
    412444399444025

  • Regulatory crackdown on IPO grey‑market premiums – SEBI has warned against using GMP figures for IPO pricing, urging investors to rely on official valuations.
    4392444020

  • Infrastructure contracts and services – RVNL secured an ₹86.58 cr hospital contract from NMDC; Delta Air Lines restored flight automation after Atlanta delays; Adani Enterprises incorporated a road‑flyover company for NH‑60.
    440214408441103

  • Digital‑banking fraud protection – RBI proposes a “Stop Switch” to block digital debits instantly and a Trusted‑Person mechanism for large transfers.
    44083

  • Emerging service‑sector opportunities – Cashfree’s AI‑agent wallet, Trishakti Industries’ CWIP fleet, and NLC India Renewables’ IPO filing illustrate growth in fintech, logistics, and renewable‑energy services.
    426964279841104

Signals

  • Positive
  • Nvidia’s CEO return and subsequent share rally signal strong investor confidence in AI‑driven growth.
  • EV sales surge and infrastructure contracts (RVNL, Delta, Adani) indicate robust demand for services and construction.

  • RBI’s Stop Switch could reduce fraud, boosting consumer trust in digital banking.

  • Negative / Risks

  • Tata’s review of Air India may lead to divestment or restructuring costs, affecting group earnings.
  • SEBI’s crackdown on IPO grey‑market premiums could dampen speculative inflows into new issues.
  • Hyundai’s price hike may temper demand for new vehicles amid rising cost of living.
  • Rising steel demand requires massive capital outlay; any slowdown could strain industry finances.

After a sharp 2 % market sell‑off, Indian equities are buoyed by record FII inflows, robust Q2 earnings, a resurgent AI rally and a $120 bn Adani capex push – but the crash, profit‑booking and sector‑specific losses still loom.

One line: Jensen Huang is reinstated as Nvidia CEO following political intervention, triggering a 29% stock surge, while Rockstar’s GTA VI shatters launch records.

The big stories

  • Nvidia Chaos: Jensen Huang has been reinstated as Nvidia CEO just 11 days after his ouster, following personal intervention from President Trump. The move sparked a 29% rally in Nvidia shares, lifting broader semiconductor and AI stocks.
  • GTA VI Records: Rockstar Games’ Grand Theft Auto VI has become the biggest launch in PlayStation history, drawing 39 million players and generating 4x the day-one revenue of GTA V. 140
  • Mumbai Infrastructure: The Maharashtra government has approved a Rs 53,928 crore underground road network project in Mumbai to alleviate traffic congestion.
  • Ride-Hailing Regulation: The Karnataka government will mandate physical fare meters for all taxis, including those operating on platforms like Ola and Uber, starting in 2027 to ensure pricing transparency.
  • AI & Labor: Anthropic has launched "Claude Ship," a tool for AI agents to handle routine code approvals, while a new report suggests AI adoption continues to sustain demand for Indian IT services despite pressure on traditional labor-based models. 101143

Launches & products

  • Motorola Edge 70 Neo: Launched in India with a 7,000mAh battery, 144Hz AMOLED display, and Snapdragon 7s Gen 3.
  • Nothing Ear (note): Nothing’s first AI-native product, a pair of earbuds capable of recording and transcribing calls, is set for a December 8 launch. 123
  • Honor Magic9 Pro Max: The flagship device has begun its global rollout, featuring ARRI cinematic imaging. 119
  • Huawei Mate X8: A new book-style foldable launched in China with an 8.2-inch display and Kirin 9050 Pro chip. 139
  • Lenovo Legion Y700 Gen 5: A new gaming tablet featuring the Snapdragon 8 Elite chipset and a 165Hz display. 136

The market angle

  • Nvidia (NVDA): Shares surged 29% following the board's decision to reinstate Jensen Huang, signaling renewed investor confidence in the AI chipmaker.
  • Reliance Industries (RELIANCE): The EPFO has informed trustees that there is no legal avenue to recover Rs 1,816 crore from Reliance Capital Limited under current insolvency frameworks. Separately, Jio launched "Happy New Year 2.0" recharge plans. 110
  • Alphabet (GOOGL): Google Cloud confirmed the elimination of 30 roles in India as part of a restructuring. Meanwhile, YouTube is moving to settle social media addiction claims from schools for $3 billion. 116
  • Apple (AAPL): The company faces a separate CCI investigation in India regarding alleged abuse of dominance and payment system restrictions. 118

Worth reading

tabs.html:
The big stories

  • Festive Sales Growth: India’s automotive retail sales during the 2026 festive period reached 55.25 lakh units, a modest 2.21% year-on-year increase, with two-wheelers leading the volume .
  • Industry-Wide Price Hikes: A flurry of price increases has been announced to combat rising input costs: Maruti Suzuki (4th hike this year), Tata Motors (+0.5% from Dec 1), Hyundai (up to Rs 8,000 from Dec 1), and Audi (+2% from Jan 1, 2027) 11141520.
  • PLI Scheme Performance: A NITI Aayog report reveals that while the automotive PLI scheme has exceeded its five-year investment target, incremental sales have only reached 22.6% of the projected goal 27.
  • JSW-VW JV Hurdles: Negotiations between JSW Group and Volkswagen regarding an Indian joint venture are facing significant challenges concerning ownership, management control, and manufacturing facility integration .
  • Defence Order: Ashok Leyland has secured a contract to supply indigenously designed, bullet- and blast-protected Armoured Troop Transporters to the CRPF and BSF .

Launches & products

  • Royal Enfield: Flying Flea C6 electric motorcycle sales have expanded to Goa 12; the Himalayan 750 is expected to launch at Motoverse on Nov 27 23.
  • Ultraviolette: Deliveries for the X-47 Venom electric crossover have commenced, priced between Rs 2.5 lakh and Rs 4 lakh .
  • TVS Motor: The Jupiter scooter has hit a 1-crore cumulative production milestone 13.
  • Honda: Full specifications for the CB500 retro roadster have been revealed 30.
  • Maruti Suzuki: The company is developing a new sub-4-metre compact MPV (codenamed YVF) to expand its utility portfolio .
  • MG Motor: A facelift for the Windsor EV is planned for 2027, featuring a larger 61kWh battery .
  • JSW Motors: Signed an MoU with ARAI for technical collaboration on vehicle engineering and ADAS ahead of its debut SUV launch 28.

The market angle

  • Maruti Suzuki: Implementing its fourth price hike of 2026; new MPV product pipeline signals continued aggression in the utility vehicle segment .
  • Tata Motors: Announced a 0.5% average price hike across its PV and EV portfolio effective December 1 1115.

tabs.one: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi smashes record-breaking centuries as India A dominates UAE, while India draws the first Test against New Zealand.
tabs.html:
Results & scores

  • 1st Test: India vs New Zealand, match drawn after New Zealand stonewalled on a lifeless Wellington pitch; standout performances include Shubman Gill's 98 and Rishabh Pant's fifty for India .
  • 2nd T20I: England (185/2) beat Australia (184/8) by 8 wickets; standout performances include Aneurin Donald's 85 off 32 balls and Phil Salt's 58 .
  • ACC Asia Cup Rising Stars: India A vs UAE; standout performances include Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's record-breaking fastest List A century and double century, and Harpreet Singh Bhatia's 130 for UAE .
  • Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy: Priyansh Arya smashed 181 off 68 balls (hitting 19 sixes) for Delhi against Tamil Nadu ; multiple other domestic matches concluded with wins for Chhattisgarh, Keralam, Bengal, Chandigarh, Punjab, Maharashtra, Hyderabad, and Meghalaya .

The big stories

  • Selections & Injuries: New Zealand seamer Blair Tickner has been ruled out of the second Test against India due to a hamstring injury and is replaced by Matt Fisher .
  • IPL & Auctions: Punjab Kings (PBKS) have appointed Paras Mhambrey as their new bowling coach and Rajiv Kumar as fielding coach ahead of IPL 2027 , while MS Dhoni will reportedly skip bidding at the IPL 2027 auction table . England fast bowler Sonny Baker has also drawn interest from LSG and PBKS ahead of the auction 95.
  • Records: 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi shattered the world records for the fastest century (28 balls) and double century (52 balls) in List A cricket during India A's match against UAE . Delhi captain Priyansh Arya hit the second-highest score in T20 history with 181 runs, including 19 sixes, in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy .
  • Controversies & Debates: The ICC has decided to keep the saliva ban in place despite Shubman Gill calling for its reconsideration to help bowlers in batting-friendly conditions . Meanwhile, fresh revelations and claims from AB de Villiers regarding the 2018 ball-tampering scandal have put David Warner and the Australian team back in the spotlight ahead of the India tour .

Coming up

  • 2nd Test: India vs New Zealand, starting November 27 in Christchurch .
